name: Lancaster University
description: Lancaster has a world-class reputation for research and teaching excellence, with many academics being leaders within their fields of study and is consistently highly ranked in major league tables. One of only a handful of British universities with a collegiate system, each of the 12,000 students belongs to a specific college, making for a dynamic and diverse community on one of the safest campuses in the UK. Lancaster boasts a global community of over 138,000 alumni in more than 180 countries across the world. Timestamps Updated
